implementation.primitive: Factor the sequency Hadamard texture-energy projection into independently derived four-point integer butterflies. Replace general Gray-code basis products, preserving frequency order, weights, magnitudes and exact accumulation. Source energies are still computed at each existing candidate call; no second primitive or cache.
implementation.ownership: Same64-byte row scratch, borrowed source/weights, layout validation and outer work/cancellation/admission. No new owned storage, reservation, per-block allocation, mode or upstream implementation data. Squared error, quantization, reconstruction and output ownership remain unchanged.
implementation.arithmetic: Byte samples bound row magnitudes at1020, final coefficients at4080; nonnegative weights sum256, so signedInt32 energy cannot overflow. No scale or rounding change.
